newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 18.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast's defence minister, Bandama N'Gatta, tells newly promoted soldiers that their duty is to defend the nation, promote stability and security and be agents of peace.

- Ivorian Moslem leader, Imam Idriss Koudous Kone, urges the nation's Moslems on birthday of Prophet Mohammad to reject efforts to sow division within their community; Presidential adviser for religious Affairs Leon Konan Koffi urges the community to respect traditions of tolerance and fraternity.
- La Voie journalist Aline Lago detained in western town of Man for reporting comments made in court by a suspect linking a theft to a local official.
- Members of Ivory Coast's presidential guard are unhappy with their working conditions and want to meet President Henri Konan Bedie to air their grievances
- Ivorian student leaders say authorities at Ivory Coast's biggest university, Cocody campus in Abidjan, did not do enough to settle a dispute over grants and academic conditions;
welcomes desire to save the academic year with an extension after the annual mid-year break but says they must ensure resits are held rather than single session exams.
